description: One input channel of the Chained Mixer, with a fader, pan, mute, solo and two aux sends; it has no output of its own and feeds the Master beside it

params.text: Sets the level sent to the aux 1 bus, taken after the fader, off at the bottom and 0dB at the top
Sets the level sent to the aux 2 bus, taken after the fader, off at the bottom and 0dB at the top
Places the signal across the stereo field; with one input patched it pans, 3dB down in the centre, and with both patched it balances the two sides, unattenuated in the centre
Sets the channel level, silent at the bottom, 0dB at the marked position and 12dB at the top
Drops every channel that is not soloed out of the mix; a channel that is both soloed and muted is muted

inputs.text: The left input, or the only input if this jack alone is patched; polyphonic channels are summed to one before mixing
The right input; with this jack alone patched the channel runs mono from it

notes: this module produces no sound by itself: it needs a Chained Mixer Master in the same unbroken run of Chained Mixer modules, and the audio comes out of the Master
up to 16 channels feed one Master; counting from the left, a seventeenth and beyond is switched off and shows no number on its panel
the panel carries no lettering of its own; the words AUX1, AUX2, PAN/BAL, 0dB, SOLO and MUTE are printed on the Master panel and run across the whole row
mute and solo do not interact, so a channel can be left in both at once, in which case it is silent
